name: ecoli_pdb_benchmark
description: Benchmark dataset for evaluating protein structure prediction and comparison methods on Escherichia coli proteins using experimentally determined PDB structures as ground truth. It is intended to assess how well computational models recover native 3D conformations for a curated set of E. coli proteins, enabling per-target and aggregate comparisons across methods.
reputation: Niche benchmark used within structural biology and protein modeling communities; moderate domain-specific recognition.
